context: A year in the soccer club

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: サッカー部に所属して、もう一年か。
lines.en: A year already in the soccer club, huh.
lines.style: reflective friend marking time, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 入学のときは、初心者だったよね。
lines.en: You were a beginner when you enrolled.
lines.style: friend reminiscing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コーチの育成のおかげで、上達したよ。
lines.en: Thanks to the coach’s nurturing, I improved.
lines.style: grateful friend crediting, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試合は日曜日が多いの？
lines.style: curious friend asking, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。勝った翌日は、気分がいいね。
lines.en: Yeah. The day after a win feels great.
lines.style: happy friend recalling, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レギュラーの割合、どれくらい？
lines.style: friend probing competition, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 半分くらいかな。ともかく、練習あるのみ。
lines.en: About half. Anyway, it’s all practice.
lines.style: determined friend resolving, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部の活動、漫画雑誌の連載みたいに毎週だね。
lines.en: Club activity is weekly, like a magazine serial.
lines.style: playful friend drawing a comparison, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
